description: This file defines the NotesService class which handles business logic related to notes in a note-taking application. It provides methods to list, get, create, update, and delete notes, mapping domain models to data transfer objects (DTOs).

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Handles business logic for notes, including CRUD operations and mapping to DTOs.

methods.name: ListAsync
methods.description: Lists all notes in descending order of update time.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its unique identifier or null if not found.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new note from a request DTO and returns its detailed DTO.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with new data, returns the updated note DTO or null if not found.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a note by id, returning true if successful.
